semanticsProbes: Generated pages (scratch, not kept) checked line, paragraph (indent over 0.5 pt), space synthesis (0.15 and 0.8 em), fake-bold, clip, mediabox, fill+stroke, invisible, marked-content, ActualText and search (hyphen joins, whitespace runs, line breaks, non-overlapping hits) behavior; the durable cases are in tests/view.rs.
knownDeviations: Text drawn only as a clip (Tr 7) is neither extracted nor searchable: hayro emits no glyph run for it. MuPDF extracts and finds it.

Pages whose content invokes itself through a form, pattern, soft mask or Type3 glyph, or that expand past 2^20 content-stream runs, are refused with ViewError::TooComplex. MuPDF skips the recursive call and draws the rest.
Annotations and widgets without a stored appearance render blank (no appearance synthesis); MuPDF synthesizes them. Recorded in APP-ENGINE-DESIGN.md for the annotations and forms op groups.
No layer-visibility input: hayro reads optional content from the catalog's /OCProperties /D only. Recorded in APP-ENGINE-DESIGN.md for the layers port (an edited /D in the render overlay).

NoView and Popup annotations are hidden by renaming their /AP key in a private copy of the bytes; annotations stored in object streams are still drawn. Invisible-flag and optional-content-hidden annotations are drawn.

Search reports one hit per match. MuPDF reports every match after the first as one hit per quad (same quads), and cuts the last hit short at its quad limit where this engine leaves it out and sets truncated.

ActualText alignment: shared prefix and suffix keep their glyphs, middle characters take middle glyphs in order. MuPDF differs in geometry when the first character matches; the page text is the same in the fixtures.
WinAnsi 0xA0 and 0xAD in non-embedded base-14 fonts read as U+00A0 and U+00AD (hayro's table); MuPDF reports space and hyphen. ZapfDingbats glyphs read U+FFFD (MuPDF returns control characters).
Type3 glyph names are looked up in the crate's 378-name encoding table plus the Greek letters, not MuPDF's full glyph list. A name like 'u1F600' gives U+1F600 where MuPDF truncates to U+F600.

Type3 glyph runs are matched to the page's Type3 show operations by order and glyph count (hayro does not expose Type3 char codes). Type3 text hidden by optional content can shift that match to a later run of the same length; unmatched runs fall back to U+FFFD with advances estimated from glyph spacing.
MCIDs inside form XObjects get no structure-tree ActualText.
Bare CFF and Type1 embedded programs: ascender/descender come from the FontDescriptor or default to 0.8/-0.2; style flags from descriptor flags.
Vertical writing (Identity-V) is laid out as horizontal text.
Degenerate page boxes (empty or disjoint CropBox) get MuPDF's pixel size, but hayro clips content to its own crop box.
The owner password of a revision 2-4 document is checked by the strict core parser, so it opens only documents that parser reads; hayro alone handles R5/R6 owner passwords.

reviewFixProbes.note: Generated pages, measured with MuPDF 1.28.1; the durable cases are in tests/view.rs.
reviewFixProbes.unclippedSearch: SECRET text under a 1x1 clip, above the page, overflowing a clip (PartClip) and left of the page: 4 of 4 single hits with MuPDF's quads; page text keeps only the visible 'P' as MuPDF. edit-tj.pdf page 3 'unbalanced' (drawn above the page): MuPDF's quad.
reviewFixProbes.needleWhitespace: Needle characters matching whitespace in MuPDF's page.search: tab, line feed, carriage return, space, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000. Not whitespace: VT, FF, U+0085, U+2028, U+2029, U+200B, U+FEFF, U+180E. 'again\nnext', 'again\r\nnext' and 'o\tw' give MuPDF's hits and quads.
reviewFixProbes.quadLimit: MuPDF cuts the last hit short at 500 quads; this engine leaves that hit out and sets SearchResult.truncated.
reviewFixProbes.type3: Type3 font without ToUnicode: text ('ABA B', 'A B' with Tc and TJ kerning), line summaries and search quads equal MuPDF's; font name 'Type3 (4 0 R)'; extents from FontBBox through FontMatrix. Glyph names measured: suffix after '.' dropped; f_f, f_i, f_l, f_f_i, f_f_l ligatures; other names cut at '_'; glyph list; uniXXXX (4 hex digits); uXXXX..uXXXXXX; a + 2 or more decimal digits; unnamed printable ASCII codes read as themselves, other unnamed codes U+FFFD.
reviewFixProbes.rotateRounding: /Rotate 44.6, 134.6, -44.6 and 225.5 give MuPDF's bounds (half-up rounding before snapping).
reviewFixProbes.rotatedPageText: /Rotate 90 with CropBox [20 30 500 700], /Rotate 270 with /UserUnit 2, /Rotate 180 with CropBox [10 10 600 780]: page text, line summaries and search quads equal MuPDF's.
reviewFixProbes.ownerPassword: encrypted.pdf, encrypted-noedit.pdf, encrypted-noprint.pdf (RC4 R3) and encrypted-aes256.pdf open with pdf4all-owner and give MuPDF's text; a wrong password is refused.
reviewFixProbes.annotations: Popup with /F 0 and with no /F, Square with an indirect /F 32 (NoView) and /F 40 are not drawn; /F 8 (NoZoom) is, as in MuPDF.
